purpose: The three offline controls requested in NSPG13/agent-bounties#1478. Each one mutates a baseline case in a way the checker must catch. A control passes only when the checker now returns the stated verdict; if the checker still agrees with the pre-mutation claim, the control fails and the run is red.
note: These are deliberate corruptions of synthetic fixtures. They are never part of the nine-row matrix and never inflate its counts.

controls.why: The creation event names an escrow other than the case escrow. Before identity binding, replay ignored escrowId on every event except EscrowReleased, so the row still reported supported.

Refund recipient and claimed recipient are moved together, away from the escrow payer. Comparing the two against each other alone cannot catch this; the refund must also be compared to the canonical payer and the committed amount.
A timeout event carrying a deadline the escrow never committed to is not evidence about this escrow. Deadline is part of the identity binding, not a free-floating field.

Force a row mismatch, then compare the exit status of the text branch and the --json branch. Before the fix the text branch returned 1 and --json returned 0, so a harness that parsed JSON could not tell a red run from a green one.
